title: Soul Campfire Haunt
description: Welcome to a poor-man's Soul Campfire powered haunter in Vanilla Minecraft. Plus charcoal maker.
body:
Ever wanted to do more with that _Soul Campfire_? 
Miss having a "Create-like" haunting mechanic in Vanilla Minecraft? 
Then look no further.

**Just cook up the following on your trusty _Soul Campfire_...**

- Arrow -> _Spectral Arrow_
- Bread -> _Slime Ball_
- Bricks -> _Nether Bricks_
- Brown Mushroom -> _Warped Fungus_
- Cobblestone -> _Blackstone_
- Dirt -> _Soul Soil_
- Gunpowder -> _Blaze Powder_ (requested)
- Ink Sac -> _Glow Ink Sac_
- Lapis Lazuli -> _Prismarine Shard_
- Obsidian -> _Crying Obsidian_
- Poppy -> _Wither Rose_ (oooh)
- Red Mushroom -> _Crimson Fungus_
- Red Mushroom Block -> _Shroomlight_
- Redstone -> _Glowstone Dust_
- Rotten Flesh -> _Leather_
- Sand -> _Soul Sand_
- Skeleton Skull -> _Wither Skeleton Skull_ (oooooh)
- Stone -> _Infested Stone_
- Sweet Berries -> _Glow Berries_
- Wheat Seeds -> _Nether Wart_

Being the poor-man's version of the _Haunting Furnace_, the _Soul Campfire_ will only convert **25%** of the time. The rest will go up in smoke (and you thought it was going to be easy huh). 

**BONUS** Use any of the above ingredients in a _Campfire_ to instantly incinerate them into _Charcoal_ (because who wants to dig up coal for torches).
